properties.name: Root cause: behind a trusted gateway the engine can learn a design's owner only from OWNED_BY, and no host input names one
properties.statement: Symptom (flo2's fact:on-flo2-io-the-settle-hint-reaches-members-only-where-a-design-records-its-owner-2026-10-29, design 1a97fc1f1de4d5d2): on flo2.io a member a design is shared with is offered set_decision_status. Measured 2026-10-30 on the published 0.94.0 binary served as on the droplet (--registry-root, REFLOW2_TRUSTED_GATEWAY=flo2.io), one design, calls named per request with _meta reflow2/writes_for: with no OWNED_BY the member's add_decision loop_hint offers set_decision_status and no ask_question; after owned_by(proj:p, who:ajs) the member gets ask_question and the owner set_decision_status. Candidates: (a) ENGINE — ReflowService::call_can_give_the_owners_word reads owners only from Project OWNED_BY edges, and the engine takes no other word on ownership: CONFIRMED (code, and the measurement above; an empty owner list takes every named caller at their word). (b) GATEWAY — flo2 keeps ownership in its memberships table and never writes OWNED_BY: CONFIRMED (no owned_by call in services/edge-gateway/src; flo2's own design on flo2.io, proj:flo2, carries no OWNED_BY edge). (c) OUTSIDE, IDENTITY — the caller's id does not match the owner's even where OWNED_BY exists (who:acct-… vs who:ajs): REFUTED, with OWNED_BY who:ajs and writes_for who:ajs the owner is offered the call. (d) Measured the wrong thing: REFUTED, the hint text was read from the engine's reply, not from flo2's wrapper. CLASS: the engine's knowledge of ownership was tied to one encoding inside the design, while the trusted host that already names the caller per call also knows the owner and had no way to say it. A backfill of OWNED_BY into stored designs would write into people's designs; the fix is an additive per-call host input (_meta reflow2/design_owners), honoured only behind a trusted gateway, exactly like writes_for.
